meta.description: Pre-made crises in the AI output format, one per crisis and symptom stage. Used when no generator is connected or when generated output fails validation twice. Each entry must meet the same validation rules as generated output.
meta.ai_disclosure: Text in this file was drafted with an AI writing assistant and reviewed by the team; verdicts, deltas and sources are not in this file, they come from the evidence list.

output.scene: The lettuce plants look small and have barely grown since the last check. The wicks at the base of their pillows look pale and dry.
output.plant_line: I'm not growing the way I should. Even the wicks under me feel dry.

clues.text: The plants are small and growing slowly.

options.label: Refill the reservoir under the pillows
options.result_line: A little is getting through, but slowly. I'm only a bit better.
options.why: The reservoir does not supply enough water to the pillows through the wicks, so the roots recover only in part.

options.label: Add water directly to the plant pillows
options.result_line: That reached my roots right away. I feel stronger already.
options.why: Water added straight to the pillows reaches the roots without depending on the reservoir.

options.label: Switch the fan setting up to high
options.result_line: The moving air is drying me out even more. I feel worse.
options.why: The high fan setting dries moisture, which makes a water shortage worse.

options.label: Wait for the next scheduled watering
options.result_line: Nothing has changed down at my roots. I feel weaker than before.
options.why: Waiting for the schedule lets the roots keep drying.

output.scene: Small droplets of moisture sit on the surfaces of the lettuce leaves and do not dry off. The plants and the pillows around them look damp.
output.plant_line: My leaves stay wet, and the drops on them never seem to go away. Everything around me feels damp.

clues.text: Droplets of moisture stay on the leaf surfaces.
The plants and pillows look damp all over.

options.label: Give the plant pillows more water
options.result_line: That made it worse. I feel soaked through.
options.why: The plants already have too much water, so more water makes the excess worse.

options.label: Switch the fan setting up to high
options.result_line: I can breathe again. My leaves are drying off.
options.why: The high fan setting dries the excess moisture around the plants.

options.label: Wipe down the surfaces of the plants
options.result_line: My leaves feel cleaner, but everything around me is still damp.
options.why: Cleaning removes what is on the plants, but the excess moisture and still air remain.

options.label: Keep the settings and check again later
options.result_line: Nothing changed. I still feel damp and heavy all over.
options.why: Without more air flow the moisture stays around the plants.
